Wh

messages.text: good day, sarah, i wanted to buy a few of the miners listed but it appears as though 75% of the miners listed are out of stock. do you have an eta of when you might be restocking?
Searched the catalog · miner
Read the bsb b30 page

Good day. Most of what's greyed out is the US plug variant, that's usually what people hit. The NerdQX, NerdQaxe++ and Avalon Nano 3S are out in US, and I don't have a firm restock date for those, so I won't guess one.

Still shipping now: Hammer BC04 ($249), Thor P2 ($379), DC08 ($539), DC06 ($379.99), Bitfortun BS-4 ($599.99), Nexus S1 US ($699), Harlo H15 Dual ($799).

Which models were you after, and roughly what budget per unit?
nerdOctaxe
Searched the catalog · NerdOctaxe

All three NerdOctaxe listings are out of stock right now, the standard, the BSB and the hydro-cooled, in every plug. I don't have a restock date for them, so I won't invent one.

Closest things shipping now: Hammer Thor P2, 10 TH/s at ~166W, $379. Bitfortun BS-4, 18 TH/s water-cooled, $599.99. Both quiet enough for a home office.

Want me to ask Georges to confirm whether another NerdOctaxe batch is coming, or look at one of those two?
please ask about the Octaxe. the one with the additional fans on the cap····. thanks.
Handed to the team · No restock date available for the BSB NerdOctaxe; customer is ready to buy if a

That's the BSB NerdOctaxe, 12 TH/s with the triple front VRM fans, $399.99. Out of stock in US, EU and UK right now.

I've put the restock question to Georges and he'll jump into this chat. Stay with me here if you can, and if you step away the answer comes to your email.
thanks will you be selling miners from Tinychiphub like the Zyber 12g???
Searched the catalog · Zyber Tinychiphub

We don't carry Tinychiphub, and the Zyber 12G isn't in our catalog, so I can't say we're bringing it in. Whether we pick up that line is Georges' call, not mine.

He's already coming into this chat for the NerdOctaxe restock, so I'll have him answer the Zyber question at the same time. Stay with me here, and anything he confirms also reaches your email.

cool, i'd like to purchase a miner from you since i'm already on your pool and supporting your upcoming harlo loto miner...but i'm leaning toward a deal on 2x Zyber 8G with the upgraded big fans @ 20 terahash for $500.

Honestly, $500 for 20 TH/s is $25 a terahash, and I can't beat that on the small units: our Thor P2 is 10 TH/s for $379, the BC04 6 TH/s for $249.

Where we do beat it is the Magic Miner 40T, $799 for 40 TH/s, about $20 a terahash, quiet tower, built-in PSU. It's a pre-order batch, so it isn't same-week shipping.

Want me to get the exact ship date on the current 40T batch from Georges while he's here?
sure, and the bsb octaxe please.
Handed to the team · Needs the current Magic Miner 40T batch ship date and the BSB NerdOctaxe restock

Done. Georges has both questions now, the 40T batch ship date and the BSB NerdOctaxe restock, plus the Tinychiphub one. He'll come into this chat with the answers.

Stay here if you can. If you step away, everything he confirms goes to your email too.
ok thanks

Happy to help. While we wait, one thing I'm curious about: what pulls you to the Octaxe with the VRM fans specifically, the cooling on the caps, or just the 12 TH/s in that price band? It helps us know what to stock more of.

yeah more about the 12th/s with the additional fans because there have been problems with ones that overclock slightly burning out. same with the newer bitfortun bs-4...the front side above the volt regulators are running really hot. i'd get one of those but waiting to see what other miners are saying about it.

That's a fair read. Our BS-4 listing makes the same point: Bitfortun put the voltage regulators on the back of the board so the fan blows straight across them, because that's the part that usually cooks first. It's water-cooled on the chips, ~300W at the wall.

Worth saying plainly: overclocking voids the warranty on any unit we sell, so stock clocks only if you want cover.

I'll ask Georges to have JD weigh in on the VREG temps while he's answering.
that's ok, just wanted to know more about possible restock of the bsb octaxe

Understood, that's with Georges and it's the first thing he'll answer here.

If he says a batch is coming, I'll have the date for you in this chat, and it goes to your email as well. Nothing for you to do in the meantime.
did you already have your big sale of the year or are you going to have one for december as well?

I don't have the promo calendar, so I won't guess at a December sale. Georges runs those and he's already coming into this chat, so I'll add it to his list.

What I can tell you is what's marked down right now: the Thor P2 at $379 from $449, and the DC06 at $379.99 from $499.99. Those are live prices today, not a promise about next month.
